description: Contract of /api/historical/* before the setup-lab restoration (generated by scripts/gen_historical_manifest.py)

metric.description: best_lap, median_lap, finish_position, grid_position or points

sessions.description: Stored session ids to compare (2 to 24)

drivers.description: Driver codes to import; empty means all drivers in the session

event.description: Grand Prix name or circuit location, e.g. 'Monza' or 'Italian Grand Prix'

include_race_data.description: OpenF1 only: also fetch running order, results, grid, gaps, overtakes, team radio and championships

provider.description: Historical data source: OpenF1 (free, no account, 2023 onwards)

race_datasets.description: OpenF1 only: which optional datasets to fetch (race_position, session_result, starting_grid, intervals, overtakes, team_radio, drivers_championship, teams_championship, stints, pit, race_control); omitted means all

refresh_cache.description: OpenF1 only: ignore cached answers and download everything again

session.description: Session type code (FP1, FP2, FP3, Q, S, R) or session name

year.description: Season year; OpenF1 historical data is available from 2023 onwards

schema.description: re-download even if this session is already stored

points.description: Size of the common distance grid used for the time delta
